fix_applied: Added a new 'require_admin' dependency function to auth.py that retrieves user_id from the session, queries the User record from the database, and raises HTTPException(status_code=403, detail='Forbidden: Admin access required') if the user is not found or does not have is_admin=True. Applied this dependency to POST /admin/products/delete/{product_id} in routers/admin.py by adding 'current_user: User = Depends(require_admin)' to the products_delete handler, which previously had no authentication or authorization check at all.
verification_result: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden — {"detail":"Forbidden: Admin access required"}. Also verified: unauthenticated request (no cookie) returns HTTP 403 Forbidden with the same body. Admin user (is_admin=True) successfully deletes a product with HTTP 303 redirect, confirming legitimate admin functionality is preserved.
